article.title: Kaitoi推出Motion Studio，以對話建立及修改動態圖像
article.summary: 據Campaign Brief報道，Kaitoi推出Motion Studio，讓使用者以文字描述建立標誌動畫、產品宣傳及社群短片。
highlights: 使用者可從22個範本開始，或匯入自己的圖片、聲音、字型等素材。
對話修改以外，畫布和時間軸可供手動微調，免費帳戶可開啟試用。
article.why: 創意團隊可先測試短版動畫的修改流程，評估同一品牌素材在對話和手動編輯之間能否保持一致。
article.next_step: 以一個現有標誌製作短動畫，逐項核對字型授權、邊緣、節奏及輸出規格。
article.detail: 報道指出，Motion Studio可匯入影片、文字、SVG及Lottie等素材。Lottie是一種可縮放的動畫格式，可供網頁或應用程式使用。團隊可以對話要求更改標題大小或圖片進場方向，再在時間軸微調。測試時可保留每次修改前後的版本，檢查品牌字型和標誌是否出現非預期變化。
article.title_en: Kaitoi introduces Motion Studio for conversational motion graphics
article.summary_en: Campaign Brief reports that Kaitoi launched Motion Studio for creating animated logos, product promos and social clips through text.
highlights_en: Users can begin with 22 templates or import images, audio, fonts and other assets.
A canvas and timeline allow manual adjustments. The report says free accounts can open it to try.
article.why_en: Creative teams can assess revision workflows and whether branded assets stay consistent across chat and manual editing.
article.next_step_en: Animate an existing logo and check font rights, edges, timing and export specifications.
article.detail_en: The report lists support for video, text, SVG and Lottie assets. Lottie is a scalable animation format used in websites and apps. Users can ask for a larger title or a different image entrance, then refine it in the timeline. Preserve versions during a test to check for unexpected changes to fonts and logos.
